general_information.name: SORRY — DO YOU MEAN THE NAME ON MY ID? I ALWAYS GET A BIT MUDDLED WITH THESE FORMS... I CAN TELL YOU MY FIRST NAME IS EMILY, AND THEN THERE’S WANG, BUT I’M NOT SURE IF YOU WANT IT ALL EXACTLY AS WRITTEN. COULD YOU ASK THAT AGAIN A BIT MORE SIMPLY?

current_concerns.primary_problems: It’s mostly my mood and, um, the timing of it. I get really irritable and my relationships end up taking the hit... it’s sort of tied to my period, like the days before it.
current_concerns.goals: Honestly, I just want the mood swings to stop wrecking things. I want better control over them, and I want to save my relationships.

past_psychiatric_history.self_harm_details: It’s only historical, from adolescence, and it was non-suicidal. I’m not having any suicidal thoughts now, and there isn’t an immediate safety concern.
past_psychiatric_history.previous_therapies: I don’t have anything to report there — I haven’t had therapy before.; I didn’t receive any therapy, so I don’t know a time for it.; I didn’t attend any sessions.

personal_history.early_childhood: I was born and grew up... just, you know, here. Nothing unusual comes to mind, honestly.
personal_history.adolescence_early_adulthood: That’s when the cutting started, in adolescence. I was in school, and that’s really the main thing I remember from that time.

personal_history.future_goals: Mostly stable relationships... and my career, I guess.
